p.src: 1  Sing to the LORD a new song! Sing to the LORD, all the earth.

en: Sing to the LORD a new song! Sing to the LORD, all the earth.
u.src: 1  Sing to the LORD a new song! Sing to the LORD, all the earth.

p.src: 2  Sing to the LORD! Bless his name! Proclaim his salvation from day to day!

en: Sing to the LORD! Bless his name! Proclaim his salvation from day to day!
u.src: 2  Sing to the LORD! Bless his name! Proclaim his salvation from day to day!

p.src: 3  Declare his glory among the nations, his marvelous works among all the peoples.

en: Declare his glory among the nations, his marvelous works among all the peoples.
u.src: 3  Declare his glory among the nations, his marvelous works among all the peoples.

p.src: 4  For the LORD is great, and greatly to be praised! He is to be feared above all gods.

en: For the LORD is great, and greatly to be praised! He is to be feared above all gods.
u.src: 4  For the LORD is great, and greatly to be praised! He is to be feared above all gods.

p.src: 5  For all the gods of the peoples are idols, but the LORD made the heavens.

en: For all the gods of the peoples are idols, but the LORD made the heavens.
u.src: 5  For all the gods of the peoples are idols, but the LORD made the heavens.

p.src: 6  Honor and majesty are before him. Strength and beauty are in his sanctuary.

en: Honor and majesty are before him. Strength and beauty are in his sanctuary.
u.src: 6  Honor and majesty are before him. Strength and beauty are in his sanctuary.

p.src: 7  Ascribe to the LORD, you families of nations, ascribe to the LORD glory and strength.

en: Ascribe to the LORD, you families of nations, ascribe to the LORD glory and strength.
u.src: 7  Ascribe to the LORD, you families of nations, ascribe to the LORD glory and strength.

p.src: 8  Ascribe to the LORD the glory due to his name. Bring an offering, and come into his courts.

en: Ascribe to the LORD the glory due to his name. Bring an offering, and come into his courts.
u.src: 8  Ascribe to the LORD the glory due to his name. Bring an offering, and come into his courts.

p.src: 9  Worship the LORD in holy array. Tremble before him, all the earth.

en: Worship the LORD in holy array. Tremble before him, all the earth.
u.src: 9  Worship the LORD in holy array. Tremble before him, all the earth.

p.src: 10  Say among the nations, “The LORD reigns.” The world is also established. It can’t be moved. He will judge the peoples with equity.

en: Say among the nations, “The LORD reigns.” The world is also established. It can’t be moved. He will judge the peoples with equity.
u.src: 10  Say among the nations, “The LORD reigns.” The world is also established. It can’t be moved. He will judge the peoples with equity.

p.src: 11  Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth rejoice. Let the sea roar, and its fullness!

en: Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth rejoice. Let the sea roar, and its fullness!
u.src: 11  Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth rejoice. Let the sea roar, and its fullness!

p.src: 12  Let the field and all that is in it exult! Then all the trees of the woods shall sing for joy

en: Let the field and all that is in it exult! Then all the trees of the woods shall sing for joy
u.src: 12  Let the field and all that is in it exult! Then all the trees of the woods shall sing for joy

p.src: 13  before the LORD; for he comes, for he comes to judge the earth. He will judge the world with righteousness, the peoples with his truth.

en: before the LORD; for he comes, for he comes to judge the earth. He will judge the world with righteousness, the peoples with his truth.
u.src: 13  before the LORD; for he comes, for he comes to judge the earth. He will judge the world with righteousness, the peoples with his truth.
